subject: DetectionMap Function - UTMs of 2 different zones in one DetectionMap

messages.author: 4d86d2fc3be40db6
messages.subject: DetectionMap Function - UTMs of 2 different zones in one DetectionMap
parts:
Hi Jürgen,

I have a question regarding the detectionMap function.

My area straddles the border of 2 UTM zones. When I plot the map the two areas are on either side of the graph as it believes it is in one zone.

I know this is fixable as I have had to do it before but I was wondering how you can do this in this package. Is there a way of specifying this in the CTtable so it will know how to handle the coordinates in the right zones? Is there an argument in the function to handle this as well?

Thank you and best regards,

Adam

messages.author: 9c3183af58028473
messages.subject: Re: DetectionMap Function - UTMs of 2 different zones in one DetectionMap
parts:
Adam
One solution is to use Lat - Lon or another projection (that covers all sites) or add a constant to the x coordinate of one of the UTM that shifts one UTM coords to the correct relationship relative to the other UTM.  I would have done the first two solutions in a GIS (because that is easy for me). I would have done the last in R adding a new column in the stations file and then reaming the new column to the utm_x (and changing the original to a new name).
David
